databases.title: MatCalc open steel database v2.062
databases.elements: Fe Al B C Co Cr Cu H Hf La Mn Mo N Nb Ni O P Pd S Si Ta Ti V W Y
databases.phases: ~100 incl. FCC_A1, BCC_A2, CEMENTITE, M23C6, M7C3, M6C, LAVES
databases.source: TU Wien / MatCalc open thermodynamic database (created 2024-11-08)
databases.citation: MatCalc Open Thermodynamic Databases, Povoden-Karadeniz, E. et al., TU Wien, Austria. https://www.matcalc.at/open-databases/ (mc_fe v2.062, ODbL 1.0)
databases.encoding_note: Converted from ISO-8859-1 to UTF-8 by scripts/prepare_tdb.py (reproducible provenance chain). Stripped MatCalc-only statements (REFERENCE_ELEMENT, ADD_COMPOSITION_SET, ATTACH_CONTRIBUTION, PARAMETER HMVA) and fixed small export artifacts (semicolon typo in one G_PHASE parameter, doubled decimals, duplicated range terminators, stray '>' continuation markers, a REF line shared by two PARAMETER statements, two-token REFs). All G/L/TC/BMAGN parameters otherwise unchanged.
databases.used_for: Fe-C binary scans, steel TTT/CCT anchors (Ae1/Ae3), Fe-Cr-Ni equilibrium
